purpose: Complete temporal validation for Reviewer Concern #2

sampling.rule: source-wide Dask sample with fixed seed, then strict chronological sort

block_protocol.rule: approximately equal-row contiguous blocks; identical timestamps never cross block boundaries

strict_nonadaptive_protocol.rule: train all blocks before calibration; whole immediately preceding block calibration; next block test
strict_nonadaptive_protocol.purpose: retain and explain the original zero-eligibility rolling-origin audit

adaptive_protocol.rule: all earlier blocks + first 70% of preceding block for supervised refresh; final 30% preceding block calibration only; complete next block test
adaptive_protocol.operational_assumption: labels for adaptation segment are available before subsequent test block
adaptive_protocol.provenance_note: Adaptive protocol was introduced after the strict chronology audit demonstrated zero eligible seen-attack test rows. Its split fraction, transitions, model, threshold policy, and reporting rules are fixed before adaptive performance is observed.

threshold_policy.test_leakage: no test row used for fitting or threshold selection
